A slow architecture of sound

Enter a curated sound field led by {{FACILITATOR_NAME}} — soft tones, spacious pauses, and guided transitions designed to restore balance.

See Next Gathering — {{NEXT_EVENT_DATE}} {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

At {{VENUE_NAME}} — {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} • {{PHONE}}

Ritual & Intent

Each gathering is an intentional passage: arrival, settling, immersion, and soft re-emergence. We begin with a brief grounding, then drift through layered harmonics and finish with time to integrate.

Facilitation

{{FACILITATOR_NAME}} weaves breath-led prompts with sound textures to support personal reflection and collective calm.

Instruments

Crystal singing bowls, Himalayan gong, hand chimes, and a field of tuning forks — played with intention to create slow-moving resonance.

What to bring & notes

Comfort

  • Yoga mat or blanket for reclining
  • Small pillow for head/neck support
  • Layered clothing — rooms are dim and temperature-regulated

Practical

  • Water bottle
  • Arrive 15 minutes early for settling
  • Phones on silent; take notes after the closing bell

Contraindications: Not recommended if you are pregnant without clearance, have uncontrolled epilepsy, or are sensitive to loud percussion. If you have medical implants or recent surgeries consult your physician first.

Evening flow & calendar

6:15 PM

Doors open — tea & quiet arrival.

6:30 PM

Brief orientation and intention-setting.

6:45–7:30 PM

Immersive sound bath: layered bowls, chimes, and gong textures. Gentle transitions, interludes for breath.

Next event

{{NEXT_EVENT_DATE}} — join us for a seasonal evening.

Upcoming calendar

  • {{NEXT_EVENT_DATE}} — Full Moon Restorative
  • 2026-03-08 — Midwinter Whisper
  • 2026-04-12 — Equinox Opening

Fees & options

Suggested contributions and single-session rates. Sliding scale availability; book a private session for bespoke timing.

Public session

$35 • walk-in

Pre-book

$30 • advance

Supporter

$50 • helps subsidize community tickets

Full pricing and package details on Fees. Private offerings: 1:1, couples, corporate — see Private.

Questions people often ask

Will I fall asleep?

Many rest deeply—and sleep is a natural response. You will still benefit even if you drift in and out of consciousness.

Is this therapy?

Our events are experiential and supportive of wellbeing, not a substitute for clinical therapy. For medical concerns, consult a professional.

Can I request quieter volume?

Yes — let the facilitator know at arrival. We calibrate field intensity to the room and attendees.

Reserve your place

A gentle invitation — create space for stillness and resonance.
